title: Write one-shot insect realism desktop app implementation plan
objective: Turn the approved desktop app design spec into one comprehensive implementation plan that an Astra agent can execute end-to-end in a single request without stopping between milestones.
acceptance_criteria: Plan covers the entire approved design from repository inspection through packaged macOS and Windows artifacts
Tasks use explicit files, interfaces, test-first steps, commands, acceptance gates, and meaningful commits
Plan instructs the executor to continue autonomously through all milestones in one request
Plan contains no placeholders and is self-reviewed for design coverage and interface consistency
